title: Local reference rents, listed by BRMA and property size (July 2026)
text:
The data contains the following terms:

 Term 
 Explanation 

 BRMA  ( LRR ) 
 Broad rental market area (local reference rents) – an area where a tenant lives and accesses facilities and services related to health, education, recreation, personal banking and shopping, across which local reference rents are determined 

 CAT 1A 
 Category 1A – One room let with substantial board and attendance 

 CAT 1B 
 Category 1B – One room with shared use of a kitchen, toilet, bathroom and living room 

 CAT 1C 
 Category 1C – Any other one-room letting 

 The  Housing Benefit referral section of the Rent Officer Handbook  explains in detail how  LRR  is determined for any  BRMA .

 For previous releases, see the  National Archives website .
